caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a long, turned wooden handle attached to a round, shallow metal pan. The handle is light brown in color with a polished finish and decorative, bulbous sections carved at the top. The metal pan, which is attached to the handle with a small bracket, has a brass-like, yellowish-golden color and features circular piercings and an etched floral pattern on its surface. There are also a few small, reddish rivets or decorative elements near where the handle meets the pan. The object is centrally placed on a plain, off-white background with no additional elements visible. The artist’s signature appears near the lower right edge.
title: Bed Warming Pan
